title: Fishing Koushien II
overview:
Experience four kinds of fishing realistically!

Fishing Koushien II is a four-round fishing competition for one or two players, supervised by tackle maker Daiwa and TV Osaka. Each round takes you to a new spot with its own style of fishing, where you read the depth, manage your line and drag, and race your rivals to land the best catch.

- Round 1: a black bass speed-fishing tournament
- Round 2: an offshore boat-fishing battle at Tsurugisaki
- Round 3: a herabuna crucian carp relay that demands total focus
- Round 4: a big-game survival match where one huge fish can turn the tables

4種類の釣りがリアルに体験できる！
